Evidence and limits

NumPy/SciPy supply independent numeric fixtures. qcc documentation supports method comparison; R/qcc itself was not run. NIST is a methodological source, not a certification of this software. Four targeted mutations verify that tests detect selected calculation defects. The guide and QA report identify deferred capabilities and untested environments.

Portfolio continuity

The approved portfolio masters, photographs, Kaizen evidence and AVOCarbon/NIDEC milestones have not been changed. This release is an additional product and service evidence entry. No new customer achievements are inferred from the synthetic case.
